summary: Complete E2E testing of Onboarding to Go-Live flow. All backend APIs and frontend pages are working correctly. Auto-verification logic in complete_onboarding endpoint works as expected. HR can view submissions, assign department/manager/joining date/email, and complete onboarding.

frontend_tests.login: PASS - Login page loads, credentials work for ADMIN001
frontend_tests.onboarding_hub: PASS - Shows 23 Pending, 33 In Progress, 9 Completed, 41 Legacy
frontend_tests.submission_review: PASS - HR Assignment fields (dept, manager, date, email) present
frontend_tests.complete_onboarding_btn: PASS - Complete Onboarding button found and accessible
frontend_tests.verification_checklist: PASS - Documents Verified: Done, Bank Verified: Done
frontend_tests.go_live_dashboard: PASS - Employee list with status badges visible
frontend_tests.go_live_search: PASS - Search filters employees correctly (Found 4 employees for 'test')
frontend_tests.settings_page: PASS - Settings hub loads with General, HR, Communication, Security sections
frontend_tests.help_page: PASS - Help page loads with FAQs and support options

verified_features: HR can view list of onboarding submissions at /onboarding-hub
HR can click on a submission to view details at /onboarding/review/:id
HR can assign department, reporting manager, joining date, and official email
Complete Onboarding button is present and functional
Auto-verification: Documents and bank details are auto-verified when completing (backend logic confirmed)
After completion, redirect to /go-live dashboard works
Completed employees appear in Go-Live dashboard list with proper status
Go-Live dashboard search functionality filters employees by name, ID, email, department
Settings page loads correctly at /settings with proper sections
Help page loads correctly at /help with FAQs and support info
critical_code_review_comments: The complete_onboarding endpoint (lines 565-758 in onboarding.py) correctly auto-verifies documents and bank details before validation
Frontend SubmissionReview.js properly shows verification checklist and HR assignment form
GoLiveDashboard.js correctly implements client-side search filtering
Settings.js and Help.js pages properly use data-testid for testing
seed_data_creation: None needed - existing test data used
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding to Go-Live E2E flow fully tested. Backend auto-verification logic works. Frontend pages (Onboarding Hub, Submission Review, Go-Live Dashboard, Settings, Help) all load and function correctly. Search in Go-Live dashboard filters employees properly.
